reason: I want to follow how the kidney filters blood, starting with the blood sample and its filtering unit.
expectation: I expect the nephron to filter some fluid from the blood, though I’m unsure how much detail the result will show.

alternatives.reason: Connecting the ureters would advance the urinary organs goal, but I want to follow filtration first.

effect: The filter leaves blood cells and most proteins in the blood while fluid and small dissolved substances enter the tubule. I’ll follow what is reclaimed next.
reaction: The distinction between what passes through and what stays in the blood is clear.
reason: The tubule transporters seem like the next step in recovering useful substances.
expectation: I expect the transporters to return some useful dissolved substances to the blood, though I’m unsure which ones will be shown.

alternatives.reason: Adding the ureters would advance the other goal, but I want to finish following the filtered fluid first.

effect: The tubule returns useful substances, including almost all filtered glucose in healthy kidneys, to the blood. I’ll follow water recovery next.
reaction: The glucose example makes recovery concrete.
reason: The water-permeable tubule is the next offered step in following the filtered sample.
expectation: I expect some water to move from the tubule back toward the blood.

alternatives.reason: Adding the ureters would advance the other goal, but I want to finish following the sample first.

effect: Water returns to the blood while wastes remain in the tubule; I’ll follow the remaining fluid into urinary drainage.
reaction: The picture makes the separation easy to follow.
reason: Urinary drainage is the next offered step toward following the sample to urine.
expectation: I expect the remaining fluid to become urine and pass toward the bladder.

alternatives.reason: Adding the ureters would advance the other goal, but I want to finish following the sample first.

effect: The remaining fluid moves as urine through a ureter to the bladder, completing the filtration and recovery goal. I’ll connect the urinary organs next.
reaction: The route is clear, though the result is predictable.
reason: Adding the ureters connects the kidneys toward the bladder.
expectation: I expect the ureters to be fitted to the kidney pair, leaving the bladder to add.

alternatives.reason: The bladder also needs fitting, but I chose to follow the route outward from the kidneys.

effect: The ureters are fitted to the kidneys, leaving the bladder to connect.
reaction: The fitting follows the urine route described earlier, so it is predictable.
reason: Adding the bladder is the only offered combination and completes the visible urinary organ assembly.
expectation: I expect the bladder to be fitted to the kidney pair and connected to the ureters.

effect: The bladder is fitted, and the assembled urinary organs can now be connected to the body.
reason: Connecting the kidney pair to the body is the only offered combination and advances the remaining goal.
expectation: I expect the urinary organs to join the body and complete the remaining goal.

effect: The kidneys are now connected to the body's circulation, and the urinary organs goal is complete.
reaction: The final connection makes the kidney's relationship to the rest of the body clear, though it was predictable.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the filtered sample through nutrient and water recovery was most worthwhile. It showed that filtering is followed by returning useful materials to the blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was clear but repetitive after the urine route had already been shown.

surprise.text: The detail that healthy kidneys normally recover almost all filtered glucose made the scale of recovery more concrete.

arbitrary.text: No action felt without a purpose, although the separate organ fittings repeated a route already illustrated.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in another chapter if it connected the systems in a new way. This chapter explained recovery clearly, but its later fittings felt predictable.
